node.title: Grepping the filehandler
node.author: arunkumar.rk141
node.doctext:
Hi, I'm trying to do the pattern match and extract the contents based on the back references on a file handler. But this doesn't seem to be working.Can someone explain me why the printing of file handler when used like print works & not the extraction part as i explained previously? Also suggest how this can be done in a single line of code instead of looping it in the while condition

open my $a,";# prints the file contents as expected print $1 if <$a> =~ m/(error.*)/; # Nothing printed though the files has the line containing error key word. my @b=<$a>;grep {$_ =~ /error/} @b;# This does the trick and wondering why the above line doesn't work
